units: rho=g_X v r, Omega=omega/(g_X v), Qbar=g_X^2 Q/(4 pi)

profile.approximation: Quintic Hermite of F,S and their tangent fields, matched through second derivative and tapered to the vacuum

spectrum.proof: Dirichlet-origin Neumann split. Per-cell Bernstein lower matrix, Schur-enclosed linear interpolant with pi^2>9, then interval block LDL. Continuous trial evaluated with per-cell upper matrices.
spectrum.upper_trial: Nodal rho(F',S'), linearly interpolated and extended by zero

precision.bernstein: outward nextafter binary arithmetic with at least 63 fraction bits
precision.inertia: outward mpmath interval arithmetic at 55 decimal digits

gates: one radial eigenvalue below -gap and no second below +gap after profile error
phase and translation gaps plus exact symmetry kernels
analytical exterior and all higher angular sectors
reporter positivity and reduced quadratic-energy stability
independent_verification: Separate internal proof critique and replay of certificate. Negative controls include no extra zero allowed by the positive-shift mode count. Retain any failed inequalities.
